description: NEESR E-Defense Base Isolation 2013: 3 isolation-layer modeling is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Erik Johnson, University of Southern California (usc.edu). After participation in testing of a base-isolated structure at E-Defense in 2013, models of the isolation-layer components are developed from the experimental test data. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ybv4-xq74. Keywords: E-Defense, base isolation, elastic sliding bearings, rubber bearings, steel metallic yielding dampers. Published 2022-06-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
